NONE: B2 the condition of being extremely poor
› a lack of something or when the quality of something is extremely low

example: Two million people in the city live in abject (= very great) poverty.
這個城市有兩百萬人生活在赤貧中。
He emigrated to Australia to escape the grinding (= very great) poverty of his birthplace.
他為了逃避家鄉極為貧困的生活而移民到了澳大利亞。
Helping to alleviate poverty in developing countries also helps to reduce environmental destruction.
幫助緩解開發中國家的貧困也有助減少對環境的破壞。
There is a disappointing poverty of creativity in their work.
他們的工作缺乏創造性，令人失望。

NONE: › the official level of income that is needed to achieve a basic living standard with enough money for things such as food, clothing, and a place to live

example: In 1991 almost 36 million Americans were living below the poverty line.
在1991年大約有3600萬美國人生活在貧窮線以下。

NONE: › a situation in which someone would have even less money, or not much more money, if they were employed because financial help from the government would be reduced or not available
貧困陷阱（指找到工作也依然貧困或更貧困，因為不能再接受政府救濟）

example: He's caught in the poverty trap and will only be five pounds a week better off if he accepts the job.
他陷入了貧困陷阱之中，如果他接受這項工作的話，每週只會增加五英鎊的收入。

NONE: › A poverty-stricken person or place is suffering from the effects of being extremely poor.

example: Some beggars are neither poverty-stricken nor homeless.
有些乞丐既不窮也並非無家可歸。
There are few jobs for the peasants who have flooded into the cities from the poverty-stricken countryside in search of work.
幾乎沒有甚麼工作可以提供給那些從貧困鄉下湧入城市謀生的農民。
